newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to firmer.

text.p: NWE oil products were stable to firmer on Monday, traders said.
Naphtha was steady in quiet trade with crude off morning highs but still carrying supportive 30 cent gains in late trade.
Spot gasoline prices were firmer in early business but weaker afternoon NYMEX gasoline trimmed gains.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil barges were little changed at around $112/$113 fob ARA for January liftings.
Cold weather pushed gas oil up $6 a tonne on futures, but premiums were mostly steady. Russians were down 25 cents.
